agreement.label: SL-04
agreement.description: Label line box is 14px tall in code (line-height 1.45) vs 11px in design (normal), so the text sits about 1.5px lower

falseNegatives.description: Label is authored in the system font stack (-apple-system / Helvetica Neue) on the usage board and in Hanken Grotesk in code

falseNegatives.description: Letter spacing is 1.4px (0.14em) in code vs 1.2px (0.12em) in design, so letters are spaced slightly wider (the design label is still 4px wider overall because of the substituted font)
